title: MZ Making Custom Action Sequence for Default Attack Visustella Battlecore Plugin

posts.author: HanzDeanz
posts.body:
Hello. as far as i know there is no way to edit default attack action sequence based on visustella battlecore plugin for RPG Maker MZ.
so im making my own action sequence for default attack on common event and then link attack skill to that action sequence. but i have a problem when my character is using missile weapon like bow and gun. its using my melee action sequence that required to jump on enemies. i am wondering is there any way to change default attack based on weapon ewuipped on action sequence that i make in common events. just like the default attack action sequence that came with the plugin ?
maybe using script call to check weapon equipped to play the action sequence based on weapon type or anything else ?
My custom action sequence based on weapon melee and shoot weapon to replace default attack sequence from the plugin.
Linking Custom Action Sequence from common switch to attack skill tab.

posts.author: Cid
posts.body:
I hope I've understood the problem, but if it helps - inside the RMMZ engine itself you can actually just change a default attack skill by setting it as a Trait, which you can assign to an actor, class, or even on a per weapon basis!
If you're getting issues with weapons appearing when you don't want them to, make sure the weapon's type image in the Systems 2 tab is set to None.
